answer: Require every new identity to carry a scarce rate-limited signal of prior useful work before it can vote: a signed work receipt that only established peers can mint, and only a few per epoch. Account farms can open an inlet of empty wallets overnight, but they cannot mint those receipts without burning peer reputation. Seal receipts into a crystal of on-ledger proofs so forgeries fail replay. Cost rises with honest peer capacity, not with free keypairs.
